title: Predication fibration
description: JSON Schema for a cloven Grothendieck fibration p: E → C over (L, C, E) — the packaging of per-predicate fiber algebras into a single fibered category. The schema records the data: parameter residuated lattice, base predicate-category, entity-set, and the fibers as a map from predicate to fiber-algebra. The three axioms — A1 fiber uniformity, A2 generator action, A3 fiber structure preservation — are runtime properties checked by a verifier.

lattice.description: The residuated lattice L that parameterizes every fiber's twist product.

base.description: The base category C of the fibration — the predicate-category whose objects are predicates and whose morphisms are the four canonical generator classes.

entity-set.description: The entity-set E indexing the fiber algebras via E × E.

fibers.description: Map from predicate-slug to the fiber-algebra E_p over that predicate. Axiom A1 requires E_p ≅ A_p = L^⋈^(E×E) for every p.

cleavage.description: Optional cleavage data — a record of which cartesian lift was chosen at each (predicate-morphism, target-fiber-element) pair. Stored as a map from (morphism-id) to a reindexing-action descriptor. When absent, the cleavage is computed lazily from A2.
